faq.question: What is the price of 21k gold per gram in Germany today?
faq.answer: The price of 21k gold per gram in Germany today hovers around 64.27 EUR. 21k is widely preferred among Middle Eastern communities in Germany for traditional jewelry.

faq.question: Is buying gold bars VAT-free in Germany?
faq.answer: Yes, under German tax law, investment gold (24k bullion bars and certified gold coins) is completely exempt from 19% VAT (MwSt).

faq.question: What is the difference between gold buy and sell price (Spread) in Germany?
faq.answer: The buying price is what you pay to dealers or banks, while the selling (melt/scrap) price is what dealers pay when buying from you. Bullion bars have the lowest spread.

faq.question: Can I travel with gold through German airports?
faq.answer: Yes, but under EU customs rules, cash or precious metals exceeding 10,000 EUR per person must be officially declared upon entering or leaving the EU.
